topic: fix a wobbly chair with loose corner braces
core_question: How do you stop a chair from wobbling when the corner braces underneath have come loose? (secondary: How do I stop my cat from scratching the couch or furniture?)
answer_summary: Flip the chair over, locate the wooden or metal corner braces under the seat, and tighten their screws (adding wood glue to stripped holes if needed) to pull the frame snug again.; after the topic shift: Place an appealing scratching post next to the targeted furniture, reward its use, and make the furniture less appealing with double-sided tape or a deterrent spray while trimming claws regularly.
persona: impatient and curt; texting quickly with typos here and there

messages.content: Wooden. Wobble at corners. Not looked under.
